Verify a Signature Here and Again With OpenSSL

Source: R/xcheck.R
cpsxvrf.Rd

Checks an ML-DSA or SLH-DSA signature twice: with this package's own implementation (cpsvrf()) and with the openssl program (version 3.5 or later), which implements FIPS 204 and 205 independently. The signature counts as cross-verified only when both accept it.

Usage

cpsxvrf(msg, sig, key, ctx = NULL, openssl = Sys.which("openssl"))

Arguments

msg

The signed message: a string or a raw vector, as given to cpssign().

sig

A signature from cpssign().

key

The signer's key from fipskg() or fipspubkey(); only its public half is used.

ctx

The context string the signature was made with, or NULL.

openssl

Path to the openssl program. The default looks it up on the PATH.

Value

A list of class rmbl_xvrf: ok (TRUE only when both implementations accept the signature), ours and openssl (each verdict; openssl is NA when it could not be asked), agree, version (OpenSSL's, or NA), reason (why OpenSSL gave no verdict, or NA) and scheme. It prints as a box that opens with the verdict.

Details

OpenSSL is never required. When it is missing, older than 3.5, or the signature is one OpenSSL cannot check (XMSS, an HMAC tag, or a pre-hashed signature), its verdict is NA with the reason, and the result says the signature was verified here only.

The public key is written as a standard SubjectPublicKeyInfo (the NIST object identifiers for each parameter set), the message and the signature as raw bytes, and openssl pkeyutl -verify -rawin checks them, with the context string passed as hexcontext-string. Nothing is sent anywhere: the files live in a temporary folder that is removed afterwards.

See also

cpsvrf() for this package's verdict alone, fipskg().

Examples

key <- fipskg("ML-DSA-44")
sig <- cpssign("a manifest digest", key, ctx = "release")

# Both implementations accept it (or OpenSSL is reported as absent).
cpsxvrf("a manifest digest", sig, fipspubkey(key), ctx = "release")
#> ╭── Signature: verified here; OpenSSL gave no verdict ────────────────────╮
#> │ ✖ NOT VERIFIED                                                          │
#> │                                                                         │
#> │   Scheme        ML-DSA-44                                               │
#> │   This package  accepts                                                 │
#> │   OpenSSL       no verdict (OpenSSL 3.0.13)                             │
#> │                                                                         │
#> │   OpenSSL 3.0.13 is older than 3.5, which first added ML-DSA and        │
#> │   SLH-DSA.                                                              │
#> │                                                                         │
#> │   Only this package's implementation checked it; install OpenSSL 3.5 or │
#> │   later for an independent second verdict.                              │
#> ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

# A changed message fails in both.
cpsxvrf("a manifest digest!", sig, key, ctx = "release")$ok
#> [1] FALSE
